quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a work colleague have different opinions about how to organise a shared project.
quests.correctAnswer: Suggest a meeting to discuss both ideas
quests.hint: Invite collaboration: 'Can we look at both approaches together? Maybe we can combine the best parts.'
quests.explanation: Inviting dialogue shows respect and often leads to stronger solutions than either idea alone.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a work colleague have different opinions about how to organise a shared project.
quests.correctAnswer: Write down the pros and cons of each approach
quests.hint: Listing advantages and disadvantages of both approaches makes the decision easier and less personal.
quests.explanation: Objective analysis reduces emotional conflict and focuses discussion on facts.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You and a work colleague have different opinions about how to organise a shared project.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask your manager to give guidance
quests.hint: If you cannot agree it is reasonable to ask your manager to decide or suggest a direction.
quests.explanation: Knowing when to involve a third party is a sign of professional conflict resolution.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend keeps cancelling plans at the last minute.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell them honestly how it affects you
quests.hint: Say: 'When plans change at the last minute it is hard for me to make other arrangements. Can we work on this?'
quests.explanation: Honest kind communication about recurring issues is necessary to preserve friendships long-term.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend keeps cancelling plans at the last minute.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask if something is wrong
quests.hint: Sometimes repeated cancellations signal a personal problem. Asking 'Are you doing okay?' shows care.
quests.explanation: Looking for root causes shows empathy and can uncover a more important issue.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your friend keeps cancelling plans at the last minute.
quests.correctAnswer: Suggest more flexible plans
quests.hint: Try planning low-pressure events: 'Let's do something easy so it is fine if plans need to change.'
quests.explanation: Adapting your approach to fit a friend's behaviour can reduce conflict while maintaining the relationship.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You received the wrong order at a restaurant.
quests.correctAnswer: Tell the waiter politely right away
quests.hint: Say: 'Excuse me, I ordered the chicken but this is fish - could you swap it please?'
quests.explanation: Addressing service errors politely and immediately is the most effective approach.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You received the wrong order at a restaurant.
quests.correctAnswer: Stay calm and wait for a quiet moment
quests.hint: If the waiter is very busy catch their eye and wait for a natural moment to mention the error.
quests.explanation: Reading the situation and choosing the right moment to speak up leads to faster friendlier service.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You received the wrong order at a restaurant.
quests.correctAnswer: Check the menu again before speaking
quests.hint: Before reporting an error make sure you remember your order correctly. This avoids an embarrassing mistake.
quests.explanation: Being prepared before raising a concern prevents unnecessary conflict.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A group member is not contributing to a school project.
quests.correctAnswer: Have a private friendly chat with them
quests.hint: Speak privately: 'Hey we have been finding it hard without your input. Is everything okay?'
quests.explanation: Private conversations avoid public embarrassment and often reveal why someone is struggling.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A group member is not contributing to a school project.
quests.correctAnswer: Divide the tasks more clearly in writing
quests.hint: Use a shared document to assign specific tasks to each person with deadlines.
quests.explanation: Clear task assignment prevents ambiguity and makes it harder to avoid responsibilities.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A group member is not contributing to a school project.
quests.correctAnswer: Talk to the teacher if nothing improves
quests.hint: If the issue continues inform your teacher that the group is having difficulty with task distribution.
quests.explanation: Escalating to an authority figure is appropriate when peer communication has failed repeatedly.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You disagree with a family member about weekend plans.
quests.correctAnswer: Listen to their idea fully before responding
quests.hint: Let them finish explaining completely. This shows respect and helps you understand their position.
quests.explanation: Listening before responding is one of the most powerful conflict resolution tools.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You disagree with a family member about weekend plans.
quests.correctAnswer: Look for a middle ground solution
quests.hint: Say: 'What if we do your idea this weekend and mine next weekend?' Compromise works well with family.
quests.explanation: Compromise solutions preserve the relationship and ensure both people feel valued.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You disagree with a family member about weekend plans.
quests.correctAnswer: Accept their plan this time graciously
quests.hint: Sometimes choosing to go along with another person's plan is an act of generosity not defeat.
quests.explanation: Flexibility in small disagreements builds goodwill and trust in long-term relationships.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your colleague interrupted you several times during a meeting.
quests.correctAnswer: Say politely: 'Let me finish my point then I would love to hear yours.'
quests.hint: This is assertive but respectful. It protects your contribution without attacking theirs.
quests.explanation: Assertive language in professional settings sets boundaries while maintaining respect.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your colleague interrupted you several times during a meeting.
quests.correctAnswer: Speak to them after the meeting
quests.hint: After the meeting say: 'I noticed I kept getting cut off. Can we make sure we both get heard next time?'
quests.explanation: Addressing behaviour privately after a meeting avoids confrontation in front of others.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your colleague interrupted you several times during a meeting.
quests.correctAnswer: Send a follow-up email with your full point
quests.hint: After the meeting send an email summarising your ideas so your contribution is on record.
quests.explanation: Following up in writing ensures your ideas are heard even if you were interrupted verbally.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your flatmate used your food without asking.
quests.correctAnswer: Calmly tell them this bothered you
quests.hint: Say: 'I noticed my milk was used - please ask first next time okay?' Keep a friendly tone.
quests.explanation: Addressing small home conflicts quickly prevents resentment building over time.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your flatmate used your food without asking.
quests.correctAnswer: Label your food in the shared fridge
quests.hint: A simple label with your name makes ownership clear without needing a difficult conversation.
quests.explanation: Practical solutions to shared-living conflicts reduce the need for repeated conversations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your flatmate used your food without asking.
quests.correctAnswer: Agree on shared kitchen rules together
quests.hint: Suggest a house meeting: 'Can we make a few simple rules about shared food? It will help everyone.'
quests.explanation: Household agreements prevent future conflict by setting shared expectations clearly.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You made a mistake at work that affected your team.
quests.correctAnswer: Acknowledge the mistake and apologise clearly
quests.hint: Say: 'I made an error and I am sorry for the impact it had. Here is what I will do to fix it.'
quests.explanation: A clear honest apology followed by a solution restores trust after a workplace mistake.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You made a mistake at work that affected your team.
quests.correctAnswer: Explain what happened without making excuses
quests.hint: Briefly explain the reason for the error but focus on solutions rather than justifications.
quests.explanation: Taking ownership without deflecting shows maturity and professionalism.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: You made a mistake at work that affected your team.
quests.correctAnswer: Share a plan to prevent the same mistake
quests.hint: Tell your team: 'I have thought about why this happened and here is what I will do differently.'
quests.explanation: Demonstrating a plan to improve converts a negative experience into a positive professional moment.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A stranger on the bus is talking very loudly on their phone near you.
quests.correctAnswer: Put in headphones if you have them
quests.hint: The simplest solution is often the best. Headphones give you peace without any confrontation.
quests.explanation: Choosing self-management over confrontation is effective for short-term low-stakes situations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A stranger on the bus is talking very loudly on their phone near you.
quests.correctAnswer: Politely say: 'Excuse me could you speak a little more quietly?'
quests.hint: Most people do not realise how loud they are. A polite quiet request usually works well.
quests.explanation: Polite direct requests are effective in public situations and less likely to cause a scene.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: A stranger on the bus is talking very loudly on their phone near you.
quests.correctAnswer: Move to a different seat if possible
quests.hint: If there is another seat available moving is often the easiest and lowest-conflict solution.
quests.explanation: Changing your environment can resolve a conflict without any verbal interaction.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner and you cannot agree on what film to watch.
quests.correctAnswer: Take turns choosing each time
quests.hint: A simple alternating system is fair and prevents the same argument from recurring.
quests.explanation: Agreed rotation systems remove decision-making conflict from repeated situations.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner and you cannot agree on what film to watch.
quests.correctAnswer: Each share one choice and let a coin decide
quests.hint: Introducing an element of chance is fun and removes the emotional pressure of the decision.
quests.explanation: Neutral decision-making methods reduce low-stakes conflict while keeping the mood positive.

quests.instruction: Choose the best way to handle this situation.
quests.scene: Your partner and you cannot agree on what film to watch.
quests.correctAnswer: Ask what kind of mood they are in
quests.hint: Understanding what your partner actually wants helps you find common ground faster.
quests.explanation: Asking about emotions and preferences before negotiating leads to faster better outcomes.
